title: cloud: HotCRM is listed as a starter (is_starter: true) on the production marketplace although its publish sends false; the platform decides the flag explicitly
body:
repo:hotcrm#1 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAnbqwN2knQqA1Wqnyy

Path: none

**Maintainer ask.** Irene, 2026-11-19 06:23Z, 「立卡」, after the production-marketplace check of HotCRM (hotcrm thread "Check hotcrm on the production marketplace"; the hotcrm half landed as objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2701).

**What production shows.** The public catalog read `GET https://cloud.objectos.ai/api/v1/marketplace/packages?q=hotcrm` (2026-11-19 ~05:10Z) returns the HotCRM row (`pkg_afe88436-3708-4c7a-abf8-e4f4c7cfe06a`, `app.objectstack.hotcrm`, latest 6.5.0) with `"is_starter": true` and `"publisher": "objectstack"`.

**What HotCRM sends.** Its service-mode publish (`scripts/lib/marketplace-listing.mjs`, `HOTCRM_IS_STARTER = false`, comment "HotCRM is a full product, not a starter template (#2420)") posts `is_starter: false` on `POST /api/v1/cloud/packages`. v6.5.0 carries that constant (read from the tag), and the 6.5.0 production publish (hotcrm run 44318880221, 2026-11-18 13:56Z) logged `✓ patched sys_package id=pkg_afe88436-…`. The row still reads `true`. HotCRM's README tells users to create an environment from the Starter template first and then install HotCRM, so HotCRM is not that starter.

**Why it is the control plane's.** Per the cloud answer on #27348 (comment 6485953428), `isStarter = isFirstPartySeed && (body.is_starter === true || …)` in the publish route, and starter listings are platform-curated (App Templates catalog in `app-cloud-admin`). So an author publish cannot clear it, by design, and hotcrm cannot fix this from its repo. Whether the flag was set by an early first-party seed or by curation is not readable from here (the cloud repo is not readable from hotcrm sessions).

**Ask (one executable criterion).** The platform decides HotCRM's starter flag explicitly, and the production row agrees with that decision: either `GET https://cloud.objectos.ai/api/v1/marketplace/packages?q=hotcrm` returns `"is_starter": false` (HotCRM leaves the Create Project blueprint picker; `PackageSchema.isStarter` in `packages/spec/src/marketplace/package.zod.ts` describes the flag as "surfaces in the Create Project blueprint picker as a starter template"), or this card records why HotCRM stays a starter, and hotcrm then drops the README line and the `HOTCRM_IS_STARTER = false` comment that say otherwise.

**Not in this card.** HotCRM's listing text on production is the pre-6.5 text because hotcrm#2653 merged after the v6.5.0 tag; it updates on hotcrm's next publish. HotCRM's `businessFunctions` (3 of at most 3) wait on the maintainer.
